_comment: Overrides for Scripts/appimage-notices.py, which adds the notices of the Ubuntu
libraries linuxdeploy bundles into the AppImage. Every entry needs a reason. Paths
in 'own' are AppDir-relative fnmatch patterns; license_files are relative to this
file. {placeholders} are filled from the AppImage runtime. A bundled file that no
host package owns and nothing here covers fails the step: add an 'own' entry for
Lucerne's files, or a 'files' entry mapped to an 'extra' component with its texts.

own.reason: Lucerne's own executable, built from linux/ in this repository
Written by linuxdeploy-plugin-qt at build time; holds only plugin paths

extra.name: AppImage type2-runtime
extra.license: MIT AND LGPL-2.1-only AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND Zlib
sources: Statically links libfuse {libfuse_version} (LGPL-2.1, patched by patches/libfuse in the runtime source): https://github.com/libfuse/libfuse/releases/tag/fuse-{libfuse_version}
Statically links musl (MIT), zstd {zstd_version} (BSD-3-Clause) and zlib {zlib_version} (Zlib) from the Alpine Linux release named in the runtime source's scripts/chroot/chroot_build.sh
extra.reason: The runtime is the AppImage's ELF header, outside the squashfs, so no host package owns it. Its texts are vendored from upstream (licenses/README.md); the runtime commit pins the exact sources.
